title: Marco Rubio's attempt to approach Harrington
summary: Brent Freriedman tells of Marco Rubio's attempt to approach Harrington, about c. 2020 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: because five or 6 years ago, Marco Rubio tried to approach him and that he got shut down.

plain: A man named Brent Freriedman, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, relays something he says came from David Grusch, a man cited as a witness on secret UFO matters. According to Freriedman, around 2020 the American politician Marco Rubio tried to approach a man named John Harrington and was shut down. If true, it would mean even a senior politician was blocked from getting answers.
